mapper.sql: game_id, attribute_key, name, value_type, min_value, max_value, description, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.attributes ( game_id, attribute_key, name, value_type, min_value, max_value, description, status, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{gameId}, #{attributeKey}, #{name}, #{valueType}, #{minValue}, #{maxValue}, #{description}, #{status}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.attributes SET name = #{name}, value_type = #{valueType}, min_value = #{minValue}, max_value = #{maxValue}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = now() WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND attribute_key = #{attributeKey}
